name: HUD
description: Info widgets on your screen: FPS, coordinates, keystrokes, armour and more. Move, resize and style them in the HUD editor.

setting.edit.desc: Move, resize and style everything on your HUD.
setting.hideF3: Hide widgets while the debug screen (F3) is open
setting.hideVanillaEffects: Hide the game's own effect icons while the Potion effects widget is on screen
setting.resetLayout: Start over with the default layout

widget.cps.desc: Clicks per second, left and right
widget.keystrokes.desc: WASD, jump and mouse buttons as you press them
widget.armor.desc: What you wear and how worn it is
widget.effects.desc: Active effects with the time left
widget.speed.desc: How fast you move, in blocks per second
widget.time.desc: Time of day and day count in the world
widget.items.desc: How many arrows, totems … you carry
widget.memory.desc: How much memory the game uses
widget.compass.desc: A compass strip with your heading

opt.item.held: Use the item in your hand

template.pvp.desc: FPS, CPS, ping, keystrokes, armour, effects, arrows and totems
template.minimal.desc: Just FPS, coordinates and the time, no boxes
template.building.desc: Coordinates with biome, compass, world time
template.streamer.desc: Server name without the address, big clock, keystrokes
